testo:
Blocker
■ This creature can't attack.
■ Whenever one of your opponent's creatures leaves the battle zone during your turn, you may reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. If you do, put any number of creatures that have "Zeta" in their name from among the revealed cards into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.
